suggest.ext-redis: Required for the Redis cache client (CodeCTRL\Apollo\Database\Redis) and the Redis backed Doctrine cache / rate limiter.
suggest.ext-gd: Required by Intervention Image when using the GD driver.
suggest.ext-imagick: Required by Intervention Image when using the Imagick driver (the default in ImageHelper).
suggest.ext-exif: Allows EXIF based auto orientation of uploaded images.
suggest.ext-soap: Only needed if your application talks to SOAP services.
suggest.ext-simplexml: Only needed if your application parses XML with SimpleXML.
suggest.filp/whoops: Pretty, interactive error page in debug mode (see CodeCTRL\Apollo\Utility\Debug\WhoopsRenderer).
suggest.doctrine/migrations: Forward schema management instead of generating entities from an existing database.
suggest.cherif/inertia-psr15: Inertia.js adapter, if your application renders Inertia responses.
suggest.php-curl-class/php-curl-class: Alternative HTTP client, if you prefer it over Guzzle in your application.

scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the test suite with a text coverage report.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan static analysis (existing findings are in phpstan-baseline.neon).
scripts-descriptions.stan:baseline: Regenerate the PHPStan baseline after fixing findings.
scripts-descriptions.cs: Report coding standard violations without changing files. Not yet applied to the codebase.
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Apply coding standard fixes. Expect a large one-off diff the first time.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Report automated refactorings without changing files. Not yet applied.
scripts-descriptions.rector:fix: Apply automated refactorings. Expect a large one-off diff the first time.
scripts-descriptions.ci: The blocking check suite: static analysis and tests.
